content.short: Biconomy v2 provides ERC-4337 compliant smart contract accounts.
content.description: Biconomy v2's Modular Smart Account is an ERC-4337-compliant solution designed to work with any Paymaster and Bundler service. The Smart Accounts are signer-agnostic, meaning you can adopt any authorization package as long as a signer is provided to the SDK during Smart Account creation. This flexible design lets developers tailor their authentication workflow while preserving full compatibility with the ERC-4337 account abstraction model. By keeping signer handling separate from the core account logic, the module enables straightforward integration with diverse security schemes and tooling.
